summary: Monday sales team meeting run by Chris Klevan with closers Andrew Jin and Richard Claessen and setter Kim Forbes-Sobers. Opens with personal wins, then roster news (Harry, Kyla and Ben are no longer on the team; Richard Claessen has been slotted in as a closer), then weekly projections against an $80,000 up-front cash month target — Andrew committed to $50K/13 units, Richard to $12K/4 units, Kim to 15 sets. The coaching block covered a payment-link incident on Richard's 'Vic' call: Chris instructed the team to stop sending payment links and to never let a prospect leave the call to pay later, role-playing the rebuttal line by line. Closes with guidance on running an open-wallet/financial-picture question in discovery and on booking Trevor onboarding calls only after payment.
notable: Stated deposit/onboarding policy: a $500 deposit permits booking the Trevor onboarding call, but the client must pay at least $1,200 before that call happens or it is cancelled — neither figure appears in the stated $6,000/6mo or $9,000/12mo offer.

Publicly discoverable pricing conflicts with the sold price: Chris says searching 'Trevor Instinct coaching cost' returns '$200 a month' and that one-on-one shows '$400 to $700 a month'; his position is 'it doesn't really matter if somebody comes in thinking it's a certain price.'
Richard raised moving Primal University from $200/mo recurring to a $2K payment on Skool; Chris said the team would look at closing Primal University to the public so it is only sold on sales calls.
Explicit manager instruction to never send a payment link and never let a prospect pay after the call, including a scripted rebuttal to 'I'll take care of it later.'

No-show triage automation sends its first two texts from Kim's number and a third from an unassigned Primal Instinct number, causing prospects to reply 'who is this?'; escalated to Angelo during the call.
Compensation disclosed: $500 bonus per $50,000 cash collected (recurring payments count), and $1,500/month at $150K recurring.
Roster churn inside the audit window: Harry Edmonds, Kyla and Ben Byrne all off the team; Richard Claessen added roughly a week before this meeting.
